$\blueD{80\%}$ $\greenD{\text{of}}$ $\maroonD{22}$ is the same as $\blueD{80\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{22}$.

To solve $\blueD{80\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{22}$, we need to convert $\blueD{80\%}$ to either a decimal or a fraction.

Percent means per hundred, so $\blueD{80\%}$ is equivalent to $\blueD{\dfrac{80}{100}}$ which is also equal to $\blueD{80\div 100=0.8}$.

 $\blueD{80\%= \dfrac{80}{100} = 0.8}$

$\begin{align}\blueD{80\%}\ \text{of}\ \maroonD{22}&=\blueD{\dfrac{80}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{22}\\\\
&=\blueD{0.8}\cdot\maroonD{22}\\\\
&=17.6
\end{align}$

Are any of the other choices equivalent?

The fractions $\dfrac{80}{100}$ and $\dfrac{4}{5}$ are equivalent. So:

$\blueD{\dfrac{80}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{22}=\blueD{\dfrac{4}{5}}\cdot\maroonD{22}$

The expression $\blueD{\dfrac{4}{5}}\cdot\maroonD{22}$ is equivalent to $80\%$ of $22$.

$80\cdot 22=1{,}760$

The expression $80\cdot 22$ is **not** equivalent to $80\%$ of $22$.

$\dfrac{22}{80}\cdot 100=27.5$

The expression $\dfrac{22}{80}\cdot 100$ is **not** equivalent to $80\%$ of $22$.

The options that have the same value as $80\%$ of $22$ are:

- $\dfrac{80}{100}\cdot 22$
- $0.8\cdot 22$
- $\dfrac{4}{5}\cdot 22$
